name: cmp-polisher
description: Generic chip-fab chemical-mechanical polishing tool: white shell, green accent band, smoked windows over spinning tan pads and sweeping conditioner arms. Origin at footprint centre, floor Y=0, +X is the load-port face.
brief: Foundry Floor interior batch 3, group A: CMP polisher (5.0 x 3.4 x 2.4 m) per briefs/cmp-polisher.md. EFEM at +X with three load-port locators, cleaner module, polish module with smoked roof and +Z side windows, three spinning platens, carousel with four heads, three conditioner arms, load cup, slurry arms. Clips PlatenSpin (2 s loop), ArmSweep (4 s loop), CarouselIndex (3 s one-shot). lod1 sibling part included.
